description: Repaint this north-western corner as one continuous frozen frontier seen from above: snow-capped grey mountains and glacier in the upper-left flowing down and right into pale snowfields and white pack-ice with a few teal open-water leads toward the lower-right. Remove the straight vertical and horizontal boundary lines and any comb-like row of repeating ticks; nothing straight or speckled should remain. Keep the same white, grey and teal palette and the same pixel-art style as the surrounding terrain.
